name: dailylocke-tools
description: Build, lint and test tooling for Dailylocke.

scripts.lint: cd .. && tools/node_modules/.bin/eslint src/*.js vendor/battle-ui.js sw.js tools/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs --config eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings 0
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && node build-sw.mjs --check
